purpose: Separate numerical convergence from a change of L2 regularization geometry
scope: post-terminal model-pool development, not prospective ecological validation
cohort: first ten original frozen selection ranks; no outcome-based selection
exact_input_requirement: Feature values, labels, spatial groups and every training/validation matrix SHA-256 must match original input-path audit 38127240195
objective: sum_i(weight_i*logloss_i)/sum(weight) + sum(beta_j^2)/(2*C*sum(weight)); C=1, balanced training class weights, unpenalized intercept
reparameterization: z_j=(x_j-training_mean_j)/training_scale_j; theta_j=training_scale_j*beta_j; penalty sum(theta_j^2/training_scale_j^2), preserving raw objective

solver_certificate.independent_check: raw newton-cholesky tol1e-9 max100 and a second fixed initialization
solver_certificate.nonconvergence_policy: record failed certificate; no claim of an isolated optimizer effect

report: Retain every first10 species and every fold. Compare held-out calibration and authorization, not biological truth or process-closure accuracy.
historical_runtime_note: Current local numerical versions differ from historical CI; all three arms must run in the same recorded runtime. This is not an archived-score reproduction claim.
